desc: Read input N and string S, and collect the 0-indexed positions of all '1's into a list.
Compute the transformed values $q_i = p_i - i$ for each position $p_i$ of the 1s.
Find the median of the list $q$. If $k$ is odd, the median is the middle element; if $k$ is even, any integer between the two middle elements works (we can pick either one, e.g., $q_{k//2}$).
Calculate the total cost as the sum of $|q_i - \text{median}|$ for all $i$.
